description: This PHP class defines the functionality for exporting charts as part of an XLSX spreadsheet, handling chart XML serialization for different chart components, including titles, legends, plot areas, axes, series, and trends within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Chart
classes.description: Handles the serialization of chart elements into XML for XLSX export, including rendering titles, legends, plot areas, axes, series, and trends.

methods.name: writeChart
methods.description: Main method that serializes the chart object into XML format for inclusion in XLSX file.

methods.name: writeTitle
methods.description: Writes the chart's title element into XML.

methods.name: writeLegend
methods.description: Writes the chart's legend element into XML.

methods.name: writePlotArea
methods.description: Serializes the plot area of the chart into XML.

methods.name: writeCategoryAxis
methods.description: Creates XML for category axes, including titles and gridlines.

methods.name: writeValueAxis
methods.description: Creates XML for value axes, including formatting and labels.

methods.name: writeSerAxis
methods.description: Creates XML for surface chart's secondary axes.

methods.name: writePlotSeriesValues
methods.description: Serializes series point values into XML.

methods.name: writePlotSeriesValuesElement
methods.description: Writes individual plot series data points into XML.
